_source: Curated CallbackContractDef entries (schema Category N) for commands whose docs specify the calling convention of a registered callback method/4D.Function in prose, not in the registering command's own signature. A final corpus-assembly step is expected to merge these into the root IR document's top-level "callbackContracts" map. Note: the schema's CallbackContractDef/callbackContractRef model is one-contract-per-command (a single string key); commands like IMAP New transporter that accept several independently-named callback slots (a '.listener' object with multiple named 4D.Function properties, each with its own event-payload shape) cannot be fully expressed as a single ref -- such commands document each slot's contract here under its own key and cross-reference all of them from the command's own constraints text instead of via callbackContractRef.

IMAPListenerOnMailCreated.description: IMAP New transporter's parameter.listener.onMailCreated callback: called when a new message is detected/added to the mailbox (requires IMAP IDLE support).
IMAPListenerOnMailCreated.trigger: A new message is added to the selected mailbox while the transporter's IMAP IDLE listener is active.

expectedParams.name: event
expectedParams.description: Event data: event.type = "mailCreated" (Text); event.mailCount = number of messages now in the mailbox (Integer).

IMAPListenerOnMailDeleted.description: IMAP New transporter's parameter.listener.onMailDeleted callback: called when a message is permanently deleted.
IMAPListenerOnMailDeleted.trigger: A message is permanently deleted from the selected mailbox while the transporter's IMAP IDLE listener is active.

expectedParams.name: event
expectedParams.description: Event data: event.type = "mailDeleted" (Text); event.msgNumber = deleted message's sequence number (Integer).

IMAPListenerOnFlagsModified.description: IMAP New transporter's parameter.listener.onFlagsModified callback: called when a message's flags are modified.
IMAPListenerOnFlagsModified.trigger: A message's flags change in the selected mailbox while the transporter's IMAP IDLE listener is active.

expectedParams.name: event
expectedParams.description: Event data: event.type = "FlagsModified" (Text); event.msgNumber = affected message's sequence number (Integer); event.flags = updated flags (Collection).
